Membership scope: BRICS expanded uses the 11 members listed by the Brazilian BRICS presidency in 2026, including Saudi Arabia. Four Asian Tigers are Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan.

Definition and comparability: World Bank metadata defines market capitalization as share price times shares outstanding for listed domestic companies (including specified exclusive foreign listings); investment funds and share-holding companies are excluded. Values are end-of-year. The underlying source is the World Federation of Exchanges (WFE). Gaps and different latest years reflect the source series and are not treated as zero.
